title: Fast and Slow Earth Changes
seo_title: Grade 2 Fast and Slow Earth Changes Worksheets: Volcanoes, Canyons and Erosion
standard_text: Use information from several sources to provide evidence that Earth events can occur quickly or slowly.
meta_desc: Free grade 2 science worksheets on fast and slow Earth changes (NGSS 2-ESS1-1): volcanoes, earthquakes, canyons and weathering, with evidence from books, photos and videos. 100 questions with answers.
key_big: Some changes are fast. Some are slow.
key_sub: Volcanoes are fast. Canyons take millions of years.
body_html:
How to think about it

Ask: how long does the change take?

  • Fast: volcano, earthquake, landslide, flood.
  • Slow: canyon, weathering, glacier.
  • Use books, photos and videos as evidence.
Example

A volcano erupts. Fast or slow?

It takes hours or days.

Answer: fast

Example

A river carves a canyon. Fast or slow?

It takes millions of years.

Answer: slow

Common mistakes

  • Thinking big changes, like canyons, happen fast.
  • Thinking rocks never change.
  • Thinking slow changes do not do much.

faq.a: Volcanoes, earthquakes, landslides and floods change the land in seconds, hours or days.
Rivers carving canyons, rocks wearing into sand and glaciers moving take hundreds to millions of years.
Books, videos, photos taken years apart and maps give us evidence.

items.q: Grace reads: “A river carves a deep canyon.” Is this a fast change or a slow change?
c: It happens every day in every town.
items.e: It takes millions of years, so it is slow.

items.q: What does 'weathering' mean?
c: rock slowly breaking into smaller pieces
items.e: Wind, water and ice break rock.

items.q: Ravi reads: “A big storm wave knocks down part of a sand dune.” Is this a fast change or a slow change?

items.e: It takes hours, so it is fast.

items.q: What does 'erosion' mean?
c: wind or water carrying rock and soil away
items.e: Bits are moved to new places.

items.e: Use more than one source.
